ui.title: Sales Forecaster
ui.tagline: A weekly forecast you can explain: pulls the open pipeline and your own historical stage win rates, computes the forecast in code with a discount for stale deals, gives commit and best-case ranges, names the deals worth inspecting, and sends a forecast that misses target to the sales head first.
